latency_benchmark.target: Ubuntu 26.04 container over SSH with 120 ms netem egress delay
latency_benchmark.play: facts plus 8 repositories x 8 file, stat, command, copy and slurp tasks with become

become.rule: Mitogen applies become unless become_user equals remote_user
become.ssh_root_inventory: no sudo under either strategy; identical PATH
become.local_without_ansible_user: Mitogen wraps tasks in sudo and resets PATH; the local fixture sets ansible_user root like production

rollback: Set repository variable INFRA_ANSIBLE_STRATEGY=linear; reconciliation exports it as ANSIBLE_STRATEGY
limitations: Production hosts-stage duration with Mitogen is not yet measured
ansible-core 2.21 deprecates third-party strategy plugins without a planned alternative
Serial transport and K3s plays are unchanged
